fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrival provides the wallet. Trust is set to 45 or 30 through TaskProgress. The harness places the player at the quay on Saturday day 3 at 10:00 and at the gate for delivery. The coin choice moves the player to the Task board through gameplay.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport clicks exercise the fair arrival, offer, refusal, coin choices, delivery, and reputation.
